title: Consent-gated submission under the reporter identity
description: Nothing is submitted without an explicit yes. When yes is given, issues are filed under the operator own GitHub login via the ambient gh CLI; the tool never asks for or stores a token, never calls the network for authentication, and never speaks for anyone but the operator. Labels are requested best-effort and per-repo label discovery drops names the destination does not carry; the title prefix and body fingerprint stay load-bearing for triage. Submit refuses without --yes unless a TTY operator confirms.
